game_concept: A puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade, a row of broken columns: the relic hunter must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Merge Convoy: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade: a row of broken columns
core_gameplay_loop: In Broken Colonnade, repeat each round: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the convoy_size value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the glyph door using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The glyph door reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the glyph door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Merge Convoy
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Merge Convoy' (Week 7 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Broken Colonnade'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how convoy_size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Broken Colonnade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The glyph door reached with actions_used <= 18.
